This '''protocol droid advertisement''' was available in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] at the time of the pan-galactic conflict known as [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. The advertisement depicted a [[Color/Legends|silvery]] [[Protocol droid/Legends|protocol droid]] set against a blue and yellow background.<ref name="Mystery">{{TCW|Mystery of a Thousand Moons}}</ref> A billboard on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] showed an alternate design, in the form of a red and yellow background,<ref name="Duchess">{{TCW|Duchess of Mandalore}}</ref>  although the blue and yellow version was also used there.<ref name="Evil Plans">{{TCW|Evil Plans}}</ref> Posters were put up on planets such as Coruscant<ref name="Lethal Trackdown">{{TCW|Lethal Trackdown}}</ref> and [[Iego/Legends|Iego]],<ref name="Mystery" /> while the digital billboard version was available on Coruscant.<ref name="Duchess" />

==Behind the scenes==
The billboard behind the [[Unidentified Death Watch assassin/Legends|Death Watch assassin]] in the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' episode "[[Duchess of Mandalore]]," shows the [[Protocol droid/Legends|protocol droid]] accompanied by [[Aurebesh]] text. It says "<small>''[obscured]''</small>EED <small>''[obscured]''</small>OCOL?"; presumably "NEED PROTOCOL?".<ref name="Duchess" />
